asks: Which statements about an added classifier are about every plugin?
answer: Every statement about the program someone adds has "plugin" as its subject: where it runs, what it reads, what it spends and what it can never do. "Classifier" is said only of what gives an opinion.

sets.says: A plugin can never act on a computer, answer an ask, set or change a rule or a precaution, give a secret, or write into another computer.
The user can always see where a plugin runs.
